description: This PHP source file defines two classes, OptionValue and Options, which manage and manipulate configuration or option data within the AWS CRT (Common Runtime) SDK. It provides methods to access option values in various data types and handles internal storage of options.

classes.name: OptionValue
classes.description: A class that encapsulates a configuration value and provides methods to interpret it as different data types.

classes.name: Options
classes.description: A class that manages a collection of options, allowing retrieval in various types and default handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for OptionValue and Options classes. Initializes the object with a given initial value or options array.

methods.name: asObject
methods.description: Returns the stored value as an object (reference).

methods.name: asMixed
methods.description: Returns the stored value as is, possibly any type.

methods.name: asInt
methods.description: Converts the stored value to an integer, defaulting to 0 if empty.

methods.name: asBool
methods.description: Converts the stored value to a boolean.

methods.name: asString
methods.description: Returns the stored value as a string, empty string if the value is empty.

methods.name: asArray
methods.description: Returns the stored value as an array. If not already an array, wraps it in one.

methods.name: asCallable
methods.description: Returns the stored value if it is callable; otherwise, null.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an option by name as an OptionValue object.

methods.name: getInt
methods.description: Retrieves the option by name and returns its value as an integer.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Retrieves the option by name and returns its value as a string.

methods.name: getBool
methods.description: Retrieves the option by name and returns its value as a boolean.
